capabilities: Publish, update and pull posts with a preview dialog
Push and pull single pages and manage them
Search site content and manage attachments and the recycle bin
Run batch draft/publish/unpublish operations across the vault
Route notes to different Halo sites by glob path patterns
disambiguation: Not an AI/LLM connector; MCP here refers to Halo's MCP Server plugin used as the publishing backend.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It is a GPL-3.0 fork, so upstream settings do not carry over and sites must be reconfigured. Deleting attachments is irreversible and requires double confirmation; troubleshooting centers on the MCP connection self-check command.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of halo-sigs/obsidian-halo.
motivation: The author forked the upstream obsidian-halo plugin to migrate its backend from Halo's REST API to the official MCP Server plugin, and to let it coexist with the original.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a self-hosted Halo site or manage that site's posts, pages and attachments from the vault.

relations.evidence: halo-sigs/obsidian-halo — the upstream plugin this is forked from.
obsidian-wordpress — the original idea came from this repo.
with the official MCP Server plugin installed and enabled.

requires.name: Halo ≥ 2.26 with the MCP Server plugin
hmcp_ MCP access key from the Halo console
Personal Access Token for images over 7 MiB

summary: Publishing and site-management plugin that pushes Obsidian notes to a Halo blog through Halo's official MCP Server.
